purpose: Build one deterministic causal M15 decision-row universe, join every BTC source event exactly once, propagate source state, retain all non-event controls, freeze a finite causal feature registry and produce label-free Track A/Track B capability reports before any candidate formula or outcome is opened.
implementation_tasks: Read only the frozen BCR02 package and the BCR03 M15 content identified by exact path and SHA.
Create one row per eligible exact M15 decision boundary.
Map all 76 BTC source events exactly once and propagate source state across non-event rows.
Create separate primary, exit, reentry, opposite-event and state-specific non-event control classes.
Record fixed event-distance, time, causal-volatility, RCI-turn and EMA-alignment strata without outcome selection.
Compute only features available from fully closed M15 bars plus current open.
Record formulas, warm-up, missingness and gap behavior in a feature registry.
Produce label-free density and data-capability inventory for Track A and the four initial Track B mechanisms.
Add tests for exact event mapping, state propagation, current-bar leakage, gap handling and no-outcome outputs.
Return an immutable audit package and update the continuous handoff after audit.
